integrity: The claims have a symbolic proof and a finite computational cross-check. The same-model review is not an independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Only odd prime base fields and self-restricted quadratic parabola for the rank trichotomy.
The singleton-fiber lemma is only a sufficient invertibility condition for general phase functions.
No quantitative uniform lower bound on nonzero singular values; character sums remain unevaluated in general.
Historical-priority uncertainty remains for general twisted multiplicative Gauss-sum nonvanishing.
title: Singleton-fiber Fourier interpolation and an exact parabolic rank transition
